_why: Environment check, not a quality check. A model registered without serving/Modelfile reports perfect recall and returns empty structured fields; nothing in the pipeline catches that. See TRAINING.md 6f.

recorded._note: good runs: RTX 5080/CUDA 2026-08-11 and 2026-09-13, RX 6600/Vulkan 2026-09-13 with the committed Modelfile. bad: same weights, bare FROM.

_floors_why: Floors sit between the worst good run and the best bad one. Deliberately loose: two CUDA runs a month apart moved references 0.821 -> 0.964, so exact match would false-alarm. This detects a collapse to zero, not a small regression.
